text.en:
Zero Percent Duty. Any importation of capital equipment, spare
parts and accessories by BOl-registered enterprises shall be subjected to zero percent
duty, as indicated in Section 2 hereof.
Coverage. The zero percent duty shall be granted to BOl-
registered new and expanding enterprises on article or eguipment classified under
Chapters 40, 59, 68, 69, 70, 73, 76, 82, 83, 84, 85, 86, 87, 89, 90, §1 and 96 of the
TCCP, as amended, upon issuance by the BOl of a Certificate of Authority, provided
that, the importation of machinery, equipment, spare parts and accessories shall comply
with the following conditions:
Office ofthe President of the 3hiltoines

They are not manufactured domestically in sufficient quantity, of
comparable quality and at reasonable prices; and
They are reasonably needed and will be used exclusively by the
enterprise in its registered activity, unless prior approval of the BOI is

Prohibition to Sell, Transfer, or Dispose. The BOl-registered
enterprise cannot sell, transfer or dispose of the aforementioned capital equipment,
machinery, spare parts and accessories, without prior BOI approval within five (5) years
from the date of importation; otherwise, the BOl-registered enterprise will be solidarily
liable to pay twice the amount of the duty foregone or five hundred thousand pesos
(Php 500,000.00), whichever is higher, without prejudice to other applicable penalties

Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRRs). The BOI shall
promulgate the IRRs governing the implementation hereof.

Repealing Clause. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or
parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this EO are hereby repealed, amended or
modified accordingly.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this EO is declared invalid
or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and
subsisting.

Effectivity Clause. This EO shall take effect thirty (30) davs
following its complete publication in a newspaper of general circulation in the Philippines
and shall be availed for a period of five (5) years from the date of effectivity of this EO or
upon enactment of a law amending O 226, otherwise known as the Omnibus
Investment Code of 1987, as amended, whichever is earlier.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 29th of March
, in the year of our
Lord, Two Thousand and Twelve.
By the President:
CERTIFIED COPY:
PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
MARIANITO M. DIMAANDAL
DIRECTOR IV
